_comment: Standard setup for sim_theorem_partii.py. factor_vols and idio_vol are volatilities (squared into F / D internally). Returns model: r_i = σ₁·β_{1,i}·f̃₁ + σ₂·β_{2,i}·f̃₂ + σ₃·β_{3,i}·f̃₃ + ε_i, with f̃ⱼ ~ N(0, 1).
_beta_note: Factor 1 loadings are biased (mean 1) — market-like. Factors 2+ are zero-mean unit-scale. Independence keeps off-diagonal Gram entries → 0; ‖β₁‖²/p → 1.25, ‖β_{j≥2}‖²/p → 1.
